notes.title: Train Valley 2: Japanese Trails is now available
notes.content:
Join us and pay a visit to this country of many different, unique experiences - rich language, long and eventful history, distinctive art, captivating architecture, world-famous cuisine and literature, cutting edge technology, and high-speed bullet trains that are known for their safety and punctuality of course.

20 valleys, 6 new locomotives, the mysterious Replicator station, new challenge, resources, achievements, level editor objects, bug fixes and the biggest holographic fish I've ever seen - Train Valley 2: Japanese Trails is now available! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643660/Train_Valley_2__Japanese_Trails/

notes.title: Update #5: ✏️ Level Editor and Workshop OUT NOW! 📍🗺️
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/8e545aa825e84878defd98a46049dbf8cdad7c92.png

Hello there!

The second big update for Train Valley World is finally here, and here's a list of what's inside: 


 Added Workshop support: level browser, uploading your own levels, sorting system🛠️
 Level editor is now accessible through the Workshop menu - with a complete set of features, mechanics, props and multiplayer levels support✍🏻


We've assembled a video guide to get you started https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLCpJDs1Kk4oL7u8TiGfdWjA-2n81kVpYL


 Three new levels made by our level designers are now available through the Workshop🗺️🗺️🗺️
 You can continue playing any level after reaching Victory screen by pressing the Just One More Train... button▶
 Trains can now start from any platform of a station if several were built
 Added red highlight for objects that will be demolished during rail construction🚩
 Signal mode train crashes now leave behind totaled trains that can be either repaired for half the locomotive price or destroyed. Repaired trains retain their order list and hired Specialist, but lose all cargo👨‍🔧
 Save / Load system rework
 Fixed escaped tutorial messages appearing during wrong levels
 Fixed looping animations played when they shouldn't be
 Numerous other bugfixes


Find a new button in your game's main menu and don't forget to tell us what you think.

See you in a bit, friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/e3bf4d7fbfb472dc72750a509e17867517e992a5.png

notes.title: Update #3: 🚂 New campaign levels! 🗺️
notes.content:
Hello there!

Just as we've promised in our roadmap, we're bringing you 4 more singleplayer levels. Find them in your campaign level selection screen, after you restart and receive the update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/2ef73c698c6c5a2f4314f07429b9f9a8b9c1218c.png

More levels = more stars to earn, so we changed price of T5 locomotives and Specialists to 3. You may see a negative star balance if you completed the game already - instead of locking some of your Tech tree purchases we decided to let you play new levels and get more stars.  

We've also fully researched teleportation technology first discovered by our trains with waypoints in their orders list. Fixed the bug and reused that transfer of matter and energy knowledge for one of our new levels :)

Our next updates will introduce a level editor - the same one we're using to build our train valleys - and workshop support for all your custom level sharing needs.

See you in a bit, friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/e3bf4d7fbfb472dc72750a509e17867517e992a5.png

notes.title: Update #2: 🚦 Signal Mode OUT NOW! 🛑
notes.content:
Hey Train Enthusiasts! 

Firstly, we want to thank you all for your feedback and suggestions on Train Valley World, after reading multiple comments here and on our Discord, we've decided to add a new difficulty level with several gameplay-changing mechanics that you will all be able to experience in our latest update, available right now! Head on over to your library to update! 

What is new?

 Signal mode: Rail signals, train explosions, and mandatory U-turns at every station.
 Both campaign and multiplayer levels were updated for Signal mode compatibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/a44bbf353ebc2bdecf5efcc5953c059f12926e71.gif

Signal mode can be enabled with a toggle on the campaign map. Doing so will disable train ghosting, turning trains around at stations without additional rail loops, and enable train collisions and signal building.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/b6db149adf885237b3eb7714b956b37f645bf00d.png

A separate signals tutorial will be available at all times with the '?' button next to the signal placing mode toggle.

See you in a bit, friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/e3bf4d7fbfb472dc72750a509e17867517e992a5.png

SOCIAL: FACEBOOK | TWITTER | TIKTOK | DISCORD

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/724d40666e9eb19a9f4d189602e89f3cff08962b.png

This past week since the release was a bit of a wild ride with all your feedback and suggestions :) We've decided to address most pressing improvements we could address in that limited time and are uploading an update for Train Valley World today.

What is new?


 We've rebalanced most Tier 1, 2 and 3 locomotives as well as Ohio and August
 Right mouse button as well as touchpad are now supported as a way to move your camera
 You can now invite your friends to a multiplayer game through Steam
 You can now see in-progress games in multiplayer menu



What was fixed?


 Camera zooming is now easier to set up and use - it is not FPS-dependent anymore
 Scrolling your level with WASD while pressing Shift/Ctrl buttons will not make your camera stuck moving in that direction anymore
 Linux users with Proton and SteamOS users now have Steam services working while playing
 Technology tree and The Great Stink tutorials should now properly track your actions
 You will no longer get stuck in the first tutorial by completing it with 0 stars
 Fixed some destructible objects that stopped blocking you when building rails in the first tutorial level
 We've added a hint to make the process of saving Curupira (level 6) more transparent
 It is no longer possible to assign the same button to two different actions
 Yardmaster specialists now work as intended - reassigning them to another train removes additional cars immediately
 Multiplayer games will now display chosen player colors instead of defaulting to red and blue


See you in a bit, friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366344/e3bf4d7fbfb472dc72750a509e17867517e992a5.png

SOCIAL: FACEBOOK | TWITTER | TIKTOK | DISCORD

notes.title: Train Valley World reveal trailer is here!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/2iPg2D2.gif

Flazm Interactive, in cooperation with tinyBuild, is proud to present the next Train Valley game that will bring our players back to the height of the Second Industrial Revolution in the 1900s.

Travel around the globe across 25 levels inspired by real-life locations like London, Las Vegas, Cairo, Athens, Frankfurt, and Paris. Make timely deliveries, witness historical events, and help discover, invent, and build the foundations of modern civilization. Welcome to Train Valley Word!

WISHLIST NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244470/Train_Valley_World/

FEATURES

 New railroad tycoon gameplay mechanics: geared up with railroad automation, intellectual train scheduling, free placement industry building, ability to connect several depots to a single production, and assignable locomotive perks our players will be able to construct complex logistical systems and support multibranch supply chains. 
 Different challenges: limited starting resources, optional objectives, and delivery quests hierarchy will introduce additional challenge—both for a chance to earn additional funds, to test one’s multitasking skills, and as a storytelling device. 
 Improved level editor: new scripting tools, programmable scenarios, evolving cities, reactive dynamic water, day/night cycle, thousands of new placeable objects, and numerous quality-of-life improvements. 
 Online multiplayer: for the first time in the Train Valley franchise, multiplayer for up to 4 players will be available from launch. Face the level’s challenges, devise a railroad system by building around existing tracks, and establish logistical and financial dominance while sharing produced resources.


Watch the announcement trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8afdaQKRdSw

Train Valley World is scheduled to arrive on Steam in 2024.
To learn more, visit the game’s website, follow @TrainValley on Twitter, connect with us on Facebook, join the official Discord, and add Train Valley World to your wishlist today!


https://i.imgur.com/xf3pc6u.png
